commercial_product.name: ZUNVEYL (benzgalantamine)
commercial_product.indication: Mild to moderate Alzheimer's disease dementia

no_active_clinical_pipeline_reason: Commercial-stage company. ZUNVEYL is FDA-approved and marketed; remaining programs (ZUNVEYL+memantine, ALPHA-1062 sublingual for mTBI/dysphagia, ALPHA-0602/0702/0802 progranulin GEMs) are explicitly described in 10-K as pre-clinical. No active P1/P2/P3 trials sponsored by Alpha Cognition.
excluded_preclinical: ALPHA-1062 sublingual formulation (mTBI / dysphagia) — preclinical, planned PK study vs ALPHA-162IN and ZUNVEYL
excluded_partner_owned: ZUNVEYL Asia ex-Japan / Australia / NZ commercialization licensed to CMSI (Alpha Cognition receives royalties)
